title: Give the first spawned CLI test a longer timeout on slow CI runners
paragraphs: The Windows CI job failed because the very first spawned bun subprocess in the test file (which transpiles svg-to-png.ts fresh and loads the native resvg addon for the first time) took over 5 seconds, exceeding bun:test's default 5000ms per-test timeout. Every later spawn in the same file consistently finished in well under a second, confirming this is one-off cold-start latency rather than a real hang or a bug in the CLI itself.

title: Mac CLI: transcribe, install_mac, cross-platform transcribe hook, generate-from-image --prompt
paragraphs:
- Add POSIX transcribe (ffmpeg + faster-whisper) and deps.sh; install_mac links tools.
